question: What proportional measure is prescribed for the four-cornered form in relation to the liṅga’s length?
premises: The liṅga’s length is taken as the reference measure.
A tenth part is specified in that lengthwise reference.
A guna-part is prescribed as the measure of the four-cornered form.
inference: In the liṅga’s length, at a tenth part, the four-cornered form is to be taken as a guna-part.
uncertainties: Exact technical value of guṇāṃśa in this āgamic measurement scheme is not specified by the tokens alone.
plain_english: In the length of the liṅga, at the tenth part, take the four-cornered form as a guna-part.
